records.Name: Process flow, part 1: Initial inquiry and routing
records.Alt_Text__c: Process flow, part 1: the web form finds or creates the Account and Contact, creates a Case per request, routes each Case to a queue by academic focus area, and a queue member reviews it.

records.Name: Process flow, part 2: Monetary and service paths
records.Alt_Text__c: Process flow, part 2: a service request is fulfilled in a screen flow and the Case closes. A monetary request becomes an Opportunity, and once Closed Won a Task leads to the Contract.

records.Name: Operations dashboard
records.Alt_Text__c: Operations dashboard with sample values: open inquiries by queue as a donut chart, and a table of neglected inquiries with queue, employer, subject and age.

records.Name: Executive dashboard
records.Alt_Text__c: Executive dashboard with sample values: top employer partners by won opportunity amount, and the opportunity pipeline as a funnel from Needs Analysis to Closed Won.
